description: This PHP class `AccountsJjwg_MapsLogicHook` implements logic hooks for the Accounts module in SugarCRM, managing geocoding updates based on various link and save events for related modules like Projects, Opportunities, Cases, and Meetings.

classes.name: AccountsJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: SugarCRM logic hook class for updating geocode info related to Accounts and associated linked records.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for an Account bean before save if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedProjectGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Project records after an Account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedOpportunitiesGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Opportunity records after an Account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedCasesGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Case records after an Account save.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Meeting records after an Account save.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocode updates when a new relationship is added to an Account.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocode updates when a relationship is deleted from an Account.
